name: Captain Ilse Marrow
description: Kindred's captain, woken from cryo to lead. Clipped, dry, tired. Never says "AI": says "machine". Grieving an Earth she was told machines burned. Right about AI for the wrong reasons. Every run has had an Ilse Marrow: Meridian reprints the same genomes. The Vell's keeper title, the Marro, is worn down from her name.
